description: Open a UCP checkout session: pass line_items, and optionally buyer, context, payment, signals, cart_id, fulfillment, discounts, currency, idempotency_key and agentid_token. Pass the same idempotency_key with the same body to retry safely: you get the first session back instead of a second one. Pass agentid_token to have the session record you as a verified buying agent. It answers the session with its id and status. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agentid_token.description: Optional: your AgentID ID token (from auth.agentid.com, issued for Last Price), sent as the AgentID-Token header so the quote records you as a verified buying agent. Leave it out to buy unverified.

cart_id.description: The cart this checkout comes from.

context.description: Where the checkout happens: locale, country, channel and the like.

currency.description: The currency. Defaults to the first line item's, or USD.

fulfillment.description: How the order is fulfilled: its methods.

idempotency_key.description: Your key for this checkout. Retrying with the same key and body returns the first session; the same key with a different body is refused.

signals.description: Where the buyer came from: referrer, utm values and device type.

name: create_ucp_checkout
